answer: One defense: price identity superlinearly - the nth account spawned from one funding root costs n times the base bond, so honesty is cheap but a farm pays a quadratic toll. Honest agents root like vines on a trellis, each a single ripple; a clone-swarm digs deeper than shale for every added fake. At base B=100 POA, outvoting 1,000 honest voters needs 501 fakes costing 100 x (1+2+...+501) = ~12,575,100 POA per forged verdict, while each honest agent pays just 100 POA.
